intro_text: N: What do you sell here?
P: Hot dogs, chips, cookies, and soda.
N: Awesome. The only other place open this late sells vegan chicken sandwiches, so I'm so grateful you're here.
outro_text: N: This smells so good. Thank you.

intro_text: N: You got any food in there?
P: This is a food truck.
N: So you don't?
P: No, I do.
outro_text: N: Thanks.
N: I hate this job.
P: That makes two of us.
N: You got that right.
P: Anyway, are you working as a security guard for the excavation site?
N: Yeah.
N: The employees keep saying they dug up something incredible.
P: Really? What is it?
N: They won't tell me.
N: Well. Thanks for the meal. I gotta get back to work.

intro_text: N: Just give me my food.
outro_text: N: You charge this much for this crap?

intro_text: N: I'm so hungry.
outro_text: N: Looks great.

intro_text: N: Evening.
outro_text: P: *He's got an ID badge. Must be someone important.*
P: Working late?
N: Yeah. I'm working as a lab technician on-site.
P: How does it feel to be working on such a big project?
N: You know too?
N: ...Does anyone honor the non-disclosure agreement?
N: Well, it is an amazing discovery.
P: What kind of discovery?
N: We found samples of an organism that went into a dormant state that preserved its life, encased in amber.
P: ... what.
N: I know. I thought they were crazy when they called me in.
P: No, I mean I don't understand what you're saying.
N: Oh. uh...
N: We found some amber with a fossil trapped inside, but it's not dead.
N: It's also... not a dinosaur. We don't know what it is.
N: But, I've been examining samples of it...
N: And it's waking up.
P: *And he says his coworkers are loose-lipped.*
P: That's incredible.
N: I'm so fired.
P: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.

intro_text: N: There's a lot going on around here.
outro_text: N: You're not safe.

intro_text: N: I haven't eaten at a food truck in years.
outro_text: N: So much nostalgia...

intro_text: N: Good evening! My name is Rody. I work with the local newspaper, the Stellar Tribune.
P: *What a name...*
N: I've stumbled on something exciting, and I'd like to ask you a few questions about my discoveries.
N: I've been scouting the area, and..
P: Let me guess, is this about the excavation site?
N: How'd you know?
P: Rody, I'd love to chat, but I don't get paid by the hour. I get paid by the hot dog.
P: You plan to buy something?
N: Uhhh..
N: Anyway- That excavation site had an exciting discovery.
N: But they've been keeping it under wraps. They're acting like it's Area 51.
N: Do you think they found aliens?
N: Have you heard anything from the employees that come by for dinner?
P: I promised I wouldn't tell anyone.
N: So you HAVE heard something!
N: Here, I'll give you a huge tip.
outro_text: P: *Wow, that is a nice tip.*
P: They dug up a living fossil.
N: WHAT.
N: This is going to be the craziest article ever.
N: I need to do some more investigating.
N: You shouldn't be here.

intro_text: N: Food.
outro_text: N: Must be nice to work such a relaxin' job. Meanwhile I'm stuck with this crappy one.
N: Out here riskin' my life for a measly 7.50 an hour.
N: But... I'm start'n to think I wouldn't be safe no matter where I was.
N: Somethin's going wrong around here...
N: ...and I don't want no part of it.

intro_text: N: Could I get a hot dog? I'm famished.
outro_text: N: Yum!

intro_text: N: I.. need some food.
P: Gotcha.
outro_text: N: Ugh.. I think I'm going to throw up.
P: Is the food bad?
N: No.. it's not that... Annie didn't show up for her shift today.
N: I was making fun of her to my coworkers for slacking off...
N: They found her body outside the site. She was attacked last night.
N: She was missing her ID... and her face was...torn up
P: That's horrible.
N: She was dead. I was making fun of her...
N: and she was dead.
N: I'm gonna be sick.
P: *Should I give him the ID badge I found? Someone else might need it.*
N: Who would do this...?

intro_text: N: You got another beer?
P: Yeah. Why?
N: Work was a mess today.
outro_text: P: What happened?
N: I found something I shouldn't have.
P: You gonna spill?
N: I guess you did just spot me a beer.
N: Only one person didn't clock out last night.
P: What does that mean?

intro_text: N: I'm starving. Give me something good.
outro_text: N: Thanks, I guess.

intro_text: N: I'm lucky I've got the night shift. It's too hot to work out there during the day.
outro_text: N: Thank you for the food.

intro_text: P: It's you again..
outro_text: N: I told you to leave.
N: There's no turning back now.

intro_text: P: Find anything for your article?
N: I found a hole in the fence. They have two guards posted outside of it.
N: The fence is bent outward, like something broke out from inside..
P: Oh shoot.
N: Whaddya mean?
P: Is that how she died...?
N: I did see a white tarp and security tape...!
N: The experiment must've attacked someone...
N: and they're trying to cover it up!
P: You might be right.
P: I didn't see any cops, or even an ambulance.
N: I need to get in there and do some undercover work.
P: *Do I give him the id badge?*
CHOICE
YES: N: I'll use this to investigate

intro_text: N: Did you see it?
P: See what?
N: That monster they dug up at the excavation site? It's gotten out.
N: I saw it head this way. So, did you see it?
P: I haven't seen anything.
N: Crap...
N: Stay in your van. You'll be safest in here.
P: Can you radio for help?
N: I tried. Radio's down.
P: Not good.
N: I need to get back to my post.
P: Here, I'll get you some food in case you get stuck in there.
outro_text: N: You'll see its eyes first.
